summary: Learn IFRS S1 and S2 with practical exercises, disclosure tools, and ISSB implementation templates. Build reporting readiness in 5 days.
lede: IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 training helps professionals in sustainability, finance, risk, and disclosure roles apply the standards in a structured way. Participants practice assessing materiality and scope, mapping disclosure gaps, and organizing governance and data controls, while exploring climate scenario analysis and an implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with sustainability, finance, risk, or disclosure processes and now need to apply IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 in a structured way.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of corporate reporting, ESG or sustainability data, and basic financial or non-financial disclosure processes. Prior exposure to IFRS reporting, TCFD-style climate reporting, or internal sustainability dashboards will help, but no coding is required. The course is best suited to professionals who can bring a current reporting issue, draft disclosure, or materiality exercise for workshop use.
